item.tib: khrid yig dmar mo 'dzub tshug gi sngon 'gro'i rnam bshad bde chen thar pa'i lam bzang
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid yig dmar mo 'dzub tshugs kyi sngon 'gro'i rnam bshad bde chen thar pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba snga sor 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'am 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ rgyal dbang sprul sku rnam bzhi'i ring lugs zab mos mtshon bon bka' gter gyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i gnyen du 'gyur ba'i skyabs smon brtsal ba dang / nye bar spral pa'i gter chen dbal khyung mchog spral gsang sngags gling pa nas kyang bstan pa'i bya ba dgos tshul gyi bka' yi cod pan spyi bor bcings pa dang / de 'phral mtshog sprul g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin snying pos gzhan phan gyi thugs bskyed rgya chen pos 'di bzhin 'bri dgos kyi bka' yang yang gnang bzhin/ gshen gyi klog pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan ming pas/ shar rdza'i zhing gi dben gnas bde chen ri khrod du brtsams pa 'di yang / 'chi med sprul sku rnam bzhi'i bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du gyur nas/ 'gro rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar gyur cig/
